'''Leigh Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Melbourne tournament (9 December)]] on 9 December 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Something-or-other (WYS)]], according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3161">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-melbourne-oz-9-12-01d3161/ melbourne-oz-9-12-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 12 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-melbourne-oz-9-12-01d3161/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
